from pathlib import Path
import json,os,subprocess,time,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collect_phase_g23_records import sha,write_identical
root=Path.cwd(); base=root/'results/phase_g/g3/v1/validation_sharded'
launch=json.loads((base/'LAUNCH.json').read_text()); plan=json.loads((base/'PLAN.json').read_text())
assert sha(base/'PLAN.json')==launch['plan_sha256']; results=[]
for item in plan['commands']:
 name=item['name']; logfile=base/(name+'.log'); xml=base/(name+'.xml'); assert not xml.exists()
 argv=[*item['command'],'--junitxml='+str(xml)]
 start=time.monotonic(); started=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')
 with logfile.open('xb') as log:
  result=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=False,start_new_session=True)
  log.flush(); os.fsync(log.fileno())
 expected=[]
 for node in item['nodes']:
  parts=node.split('::'); classname=parts[0][:-3].replace('/','.')
  if len(parts)>2: classname+='.'+'.'.join(parts[1:-1])
  expected.append((classname,parts[-1]))
 actual=[]; bad=[]; parse_error=None
 try:
  for case in ET.parse(xml).getroot().iter('testcase'):
   actual.append((case.attrib.get('classname',''),case.attrib['name']))
   if any(case.find(tag) is not None for tag in ('failure','error','skipped')): bad.append(case.attrib)
 except Exception as error: parse_error=repr(error)
 passed=result.returncode==0 and not bad and parse_error is None and sorted(actual)==sorted(expected)
 record={'name':name,'kind':item['kind'],'nodes':item['nodes'],'command':argv,'returncode':result.returncode,'all_exact_nodecases_passed':passed,'junit_cases':actual,'nonpassing_cases':bad,'junit_parse_error':parse_error,'started':started,'ended':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'log_sha256':sha(logfile),'junit_sha256':sha(xml) if xml.exists() else None}
 write_identical(base/(name+'.json'),(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n').encode()); results.append(record)
 if not passed: break
all_passed=len(results)==len(plan['commands']) and all(r['all_exact_nodecases_passed'] for r in results)
summary={'source_head':launch['source_head'],'plan_sha256':launch['plan_sha256'],'worker_source_sha256':launch['worker_source_sha256'],'all_commands_passed':all_passed,'regular_passed':sum(len(r['nodes']) for r in results if r['kind']=='regular' and r['all_exact_nodecases_passed']),'slow_passed':sum(len(r['nodes']) for r in results if r['kind']=='slow' and r['all_exact_nodecases_passed']),'completed_shards':len(results),'expected_shards':len(plan['commands']),'time':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'results':results}
write_identical(base/'EXIT.json',(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
raise SystemExit(0 if all_passed else 1)
